summary: Compresses a 4x4 float4 pixel block (a1, RGBA) to a DXT/BC block written to a2. When alpha handling is enabled (a3), counts transparent pixels (alpha < 0.5) and returns early writing a fully-transparent marker when all 16 are transparent; otherwise picks a 2-color (4) or 3-color (3) endpoint mode from the transparent count. Accumulates per-channel color sums over the block, quantizes the average to 16-bit 5:6:5, and error-diffuses residuals into per-channel buffers with 0.4375/0.1875/0.3125/0.0625 coefficients. Fits an oriented bounding box (OBBFittingAndProjection) to the colors to obtain two endpoint candidates, scales them by color-space factors, quantizes each to 16-bit via sub_513E80, and either writes them directly (4-color mode with equal endpoints) or decodes them back to float, orders them, and interpolates intermediate colors (0.5 split for 3-color, 0.3333/0.6666 for 4-color). A second pass over the 16 pixels projects each pixel onto the endpoint axis, picks a 2-bit selector via dot-product sign and a lookup table (unk_5AF628/unk_5AF618), packs the selectors into a bitmask, and writes it to a2+4.

local_names.a2: output DXT block (word0/2 endpoint colors, dword4 selector bits)
local_names.v90/v91/v92: accumulated R/G/B channel sums and later endpoint vectors
local_names.v89: selector lookup table base (unk_5AF628 for 3-color, unk_5AF618 for 4-color)

operations.description: Alpha scan: when a3 is nonzero, walk all 16 pixels' alpha (this+0xC) and count those below 0.5; if all 16 are transparent, write a2+2 = -1, a2+4 = -1, a2+0 = 0 and return 0 immediately.
Select the endpoint mode v94: 3 when any pixel was transparent (a3 truthy, v4 != 0), otherwise 4.
Zero the v46 scratch buffer (memset 256 bytes), derive a set of stack pointer offsets against the input block a1, and reset the FPU control word via FPUControlWordMerger.

Accumulation loop over the 16 pixels (v11 step 4): sum the R/G/B channels (reading this+0x4 for G and this+0x8 for B alongside the R/A neighbors), quantize each average to 5:6:5 (31.0/63.0 scales, 1/31 and 1/63 decode), store the reconstructed color, and accumulate the quantization error into per-channel buffers gated by the pass counter (this pixel's (v97 & 3)) with coefficients 0.4375, 0.1875, 0.3125, and 0.0625.
Write the color-space-scaled channel sums into the v42 staging array using flt_5D79BC, flt_5D79C0, flt_5D79C4 for R, G, B respectively.
OBBFittingAndProjection computes the two endpoint color candidates from the accumulated block data.
Scale the two endpoint candidates by flt_5D79CC, flt_5D79D0, flt_5D79D4 into the v47 and v84 groups.
Quantize each scaled endpoint to a 16-bit color via sub_513E80 (called twice, producing v17 and v18).
When v94 == 4 and the low words of v17 and v18 are equal, write the block directly: a2+4 = 0, a2+0 = v17, a2+2 = v18.

Otherwise decode both endpoints back to float via F_16BitColorToFloat4Decoder, rescale with flt_5D79BC/C0/C4, order the endpoints by comparing v94==3 against v19 >= v17, and build the interpolated color set (0.5 midpoint for 3-color mode, 0.3333/0.6666 thirds for 4-color mode).

Select the selector lookup table: unk_5AF628 for 3-color mode, unk_5AF618 otherwise; compute the projection scale factor v29 (0 when the endpoint low words match, else (v94-1) divided by the endpoint-difference dot product).

Selector pass over the 16 pixels: for 3-color mode, transparent pixels (alpha < 0.5 at this+0xC) force the opaque-alpha selector bits; otherwise project the pixel onto the endpoint axis, pick the selector value (0, 1, or a lookup at v89 + 4*index) from the dot product, shift it into the v30 bitmask, and error-diffuse the residuals with the same 0.4375/0.1875/0.3125/0.0625 coefficients, resetting the FPU control word again via FPUControlWordMerger.
Write the packed selector bitmask v30 to a2+4.
Return 0. Called by FileIOWrapper (005152EB), QuantizationColorSpaceConversion (00515303), and sub_515417 (00515417).
